sdk.evidence_basis: installed official SDK implementation source, not an Engine capability descriptor

budgets.scope_filter: exact namespace and owner_scope on all native/portable query legs

results.query: Mira cobalt observability playbook project A17

ranking_interpretation.metrics: synthetic fixture diagnostics (MRR@5, nDCG@5), not semantic/model quality
ranking_interpretation.internal_candidate_equivalence: not available: Weaviate's native hybrid API exposes one fused-result limit and does not expose a separate BM25/vector candidate-pool cap. Portable RRF requests five from each leg (at most ten unique union candidates); native requests ten fused candidates, then both report top five. Server-internal native candidate behavior is opaque.
ranking_interpretation.native_fusion: Weaviate server hybrid with caller-supplied hash vector and alpha=0.5
ranking_interpretation.portable_fusion: independent local Tantivy BM25 and LanceDB vector legs, each top-5, fused once by memspine rrf_fuse

engine_capability.claim: experimental external backend capability only; not a shipped Memspine feature or production approval

limitations: Hash dim=64 is deterministic plumbing and fixture material, not semantic embedding quality.
The synthetic labels are authored from the fixed fixture and metrics are diagnostic only.
The native backend has no exposed internal candidate-pool budget equivalent to two portable legs.
One Weaviate server version, one local run, five queries, and 26 records do not establish production relevance or latency.
No native results were merged into portable RRF; each backend contributed one unique-record ranking per query.
